topic: Link-Time Optimization (LTO) and Dead Code Elimination
explanation: Link-Time Optimization (LTO) is a compiler optimization technique that improves performance by analyzing and optimizing code across multiple object files during the linking stage.  A crucial part of LTO is dead code elimination, which identifies and removes unused functions or code sections. This reduces the final executable size and improves performance by avoiding unnecessary computations.
keywords: LTO, Dead Code Elimination, Link-Time Optimization, DCE
